acceptance: MCP tree output for a real exported DuckDB Q1 plan contains its actual operator hierarchy and lineitem scan, not a single generic Node.
MCP summary operator, join and scan counts match a traversal of canonical logical operators, exclude metadata/property dictionaries, and handle absent estimates without fabrication.
Regression tests use canonical exported/rehydrated plans and verify semantic output for scan, join and aggregate shapes; JSON output retains the canonical plan structure.
context: Draft PR #3708 stacked on fix/mcp-query-plan-lookup (#3693), branch fix/mcp-canonical-plan-rendering, head 1ef13f5e2. Resume: after #3693 merges, retarget to develop, rebase --onto origin/develop, mark ready, land, then take and finish.
description: MCP tree and summary helpers expect a type/children native-style tree, not the persisted QueryPlanDAG envelope with logical_root and operator_type. Passing a real exported Q1 plan renders only Node; the summary counts arbitrary dictionaries as operators and reports zero scans. Existing tests use simplified HashJoin/SeqScan fixtures, so they validate a different schema. Extend existing canonical visualization/model traversal rather than retaining parallel incompatible walkers.
